title: Protocol to alter a protein’s phase separation capacity to control cell fate transitions
protocol: Digest Pet28a vector with EcoRI at 37°C for 12 hours.
Purify the digested vectors using gel electrophoresis in a 1.5% agarose gel.
Collect the purified fragments using a Gel Extraction Kit.
Incubate the digestion mixture at 65°C for 20 minutes to inactivate restriction enzymes.
Perform gel electrophoresis with the digestion mixture and cut out target fragments with a lancet.
Purify the cut fragments using an Omega DNA purification kit.
Amplify the IDRs of FUS or hnRNPA by PCR using specific primers containing homologous arms.
Purify the PCR products using columns.
Insert IDR fragments into digested vectors through homologous recombination at 50°C for 50 minutes.
Transform competent bacterial BL21 from −80°C refrigerator and thaw on ice for 5 minutes.
Add 10 μL of ligation product to 50 μL of competent bacteria, mix gently.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 minutes.
Incubate the tubes in 42°C for 45 s.
Cool the tubes on ice for 2 min.
Add 500 μL of antibiotic-free LB liquid medium.
Shake at 37°C for 1 h.
Centrifuge at 700 × g for 5 min.
Discard 480 μL supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in the remaining volume.
Drop all onto the plate and coat evenly.
Invert the plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 12 h.
Pick bacteria mono colony.
Rotate with 200 μL kanamycin-positive LB media at 37°C for 2 h.
Test the sequence of clones.
Digest pMXs vectors using NotI and BamHI at 37°C for 8-12 h.
Inactivate restriction enzymes by incubating the whole system at 65°C for 20 min.
Purify digested vectors by gel electrophoresis in a 1.5% agarose gel.
Cut and collect the target fragment (approximately 4529 bp) using Gel Extraction Kit.
Amplify inserted fragments from pet28a vectors by PCR using specific primers containing NotI and BamHI restriction sites.
Digest PCR products with NotI and BamHI at 37°C for 12 hours.
Purify digested PCR products by gel electrophoresis in a 1.5% agarose gel.
Collect purified PCR products using a Gel Extraction Kit.
Mix digested pMXs vectors with inserted fragments at a ratio of 1:5 and ligate at 16°C for 12 hours.
Thaw competent bacterial DH5-α on ice for 5 minutes.
Add 10 μL ligation product to 50 μL competent bacteria, mix gently, and incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Incubate the mixture in a water bath at 42°C for 45 seconds.
Cool tubes on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 500 μL of antibiotic-free LB liquid medium to the mixture and shake at 37°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge at 700 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard 480 μL supernatant, resuspend pellet in remaining media, and drop onto a plate evenly.
Incubate plate upside down at 37°C for 12 hours.
Pick bacteria colony and rotate at 37°C with 200 μL kanamycin-positive LB medium for 2 hours.
Test the sequence of bacterial clones.
Culture a fresh bacterial colony into 30 mL LB media containing kanamycin for 12 hours at 37°C.
Dilute the culture 1:30 in 300 mL LB with freshly added kanamycin and grow for 2 hours at 37°C until OD600 reaches 0.6–0.8.
Decrease temperature to 16°C, add 0.3 mM IPTG, and incubate at 16°C for 16 hours.
Centrifuge bacterial culture at 3000 × g at 18°C for 15 minutes to collect pellets.
Observe bacterial pellets expressing GFP or mCherry proteins exhibiting green or red fluorescence respectively.
Resuspend bacterial pellets in 15 mL of non-denaturing lysis buffer containing protease inhibitors.
Sonicate the suspension using 30 cycles of 30 seconds on and 15 seconds off.
Centrifuge the lysates at 3000 × g for 30 minutes to clear the solution.
Add the cleared lysate to 1 mL of pre-equilibrated BeyoGoldTM His-tag Purification Resin that has been washed with 5 volumes of lysis buffer.
Rotate tubes containing the resin slurry for 1.5 hours at 4°C.
Wash the resin with 10 volumes of washing buffer.
Elute the protein six times using elution buffer containing 250 mM imidazole, collecting about 500 uL each time.
Collect flow-through solution with green fluorescence.
Run 20 μL of collected protein on a 12% SDS-PAGE gel to check for correct size bands.
Transfer the protein solution into a dialysis bag and dialyze at 4°C for 12 hours in 1 L of dialysis buffer with rotation.
Concentrate the recombinant GFP or mCherry fusion proteins using centrifugal filters to obtain approximately 200 μL of concentrated protein.
Detect protein concentration using Enhanced BCA Protein Assay Kit (Beyotime).
Mix 20 nM of proteins with 10% PEG-8000 in 125 mM NaCl to create a protein mixture.
Load one droplet of the protein mixture onto a glass slide.
Cover the droplet with a cover glass.
Image the protein mixture immediately using fluorescence microscopy (Nikon Eclipse Ts2R-FL).
Adjust objective at 40× and eyepiece at 10× for imaging.
Set exposure time to 500 ms for imaging.
Keep protein solution on ice during sonication to maintain quality.
Store collected protein solution at −80°C, no more than half a year after Step 10.
Mix proteins with an appropriate concentration with 10% PEG-8000 in 125 mM NaCl and load onto a homemade chamber.
Image the mixture using a Nikon A1 laser confocal microscope with a 100× oil-immersion objective lens (HP Apo TIRF 100xH, 1.49 NA).
Apply 5 pulses of laser (488 nm) at a 50 us dwell time to the droplet.
Image recovery on Nikon A1 laser confocal microscope every 1 second for indicated time periods.
Seed 12.5×10^6 293T cells in a 10 cm plate using DMEM containing 10% fetal bovine serum without adding P/S.
Ensure cells reach near 80–90% confluence when transfection.
Add 16.7 μg target plasmid, 11.17 μg psPAX2, 7.4 μg VSV-G and 450 μL water to an Eppendorf tube.
Mix the contents of the Eppendorf tube thoroughly.
Add 62.5 μl 2M CaCl2 to the water-DNA mixture.
Prepare a solution by adding 500uL 2× BES buffered saline in a 15 mL conical tube.
Slowly add the DNA mixture dropwise to the 2× BES buffered saline.
Blow the mixture evenly after addition.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 min until the solution becomes slightly cloudy.
Aspirate media off the 293T cells seeded the day before.
Add 10 mL of fresh media (without P/S) with 25 nM chloroquine to the cells.
Add precipitate dropwise to the 293T cells, distributing evenly.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 12 hours.
Change the media 18–24 hours post incubation.
Check for reporter gene expression if applicable.
Collect supernatant at 48–72 hours post transfection.
Store concentrated virus at −80°C.
Recover MEFs and plant into a 24-well plate.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-wtOCT4 plasmid.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-amOCT4 plasmid.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-delOCT4 plasmid.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-amOCT4-FUS plasmid.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-amOCT4-hnRNPA plasmid.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-delOCT4-FUS plasmid.
Infect MEFs with lentivirus containing pMXs-delOCT4-hnRNPA plasmid.
Select infected MEFs by adding 2 μg/mL puromycin and 300 μg/mL hygromycin for 5 days.
Plate cells on the 14 mm slides.
Wash twice with 2 mL of warmed PBS.
Use 4% paraformaldehyde to fix the cells for 15 minutes at 25°C.
Remove paraformaldehyde from the cells.
Permeabilize the cells by adding 0.5% Triton X-100 for 5 minutes.
Block cells with 200 μL of blocking buffer (consists of 5% BSA, 0.5% Triton X-100, and 94.5% PBS) for 30 minutes at 25°C.
Aspirate blocking buffer.
Add primary antibody at a concentration of 1:500 in blocking buffer.
Incubate primary antibody at 4°C for 12 hours or at 25°C for 1 hour.
Wash cells with PBS five times.
Incubate with labeled secondary antibody at a concentration of 1:2000 in blocking buffer for 1 hour at 25°C without light exposure.
Wash cells with PBS twice.
Stain cells with 3 μM DAPI in PBS for 10 minutes at 25°C.
Acquire images on Nikon A1 laser confocal microscope using the module of ECLIPSE Ti-E with N-STORM.
Stimulate OCT4-GFP labeled cells with a 488-nm laser.
Stimulate nuclei stained with DAPI with a 405-nm laser.
Introduce plenty-OCT4-GFP vectors into mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs) by viral infection.
Culture mESCs in dish whose bottom is gelatin-coated, and add doxycycline to stimulate stable OCT4-GFP expression at a final concentration of 2 μg/mL.
Change medium every day for 72 hours.
Select mono colonies with GFP fluorescence.
Plant selected colonies onto glass bottom for imaging.
Acquire fluorescence images of GFP on a Nikon A1 laser confocal microscope using a 100× oil-immersion objective lens (HP Apo TIRF 100xH, 1.49 NA).
Apply 5 pulses of laser (488 nm) at a 50 us dwell time to the droplet.
Image recovery on the Nikon A1 laser confocal microscope every 1 second for indicated time periods.
Normalize fluorescence intensity of bleached cell at each time point by background region and adjacent unbleached cells.
MEFs are recovered into 6 cm plate and expanded.
Sub-culture MEFs and plant into four of 12-well plates, with each well containing 1.5×10^4 cells.
Collect OCT4-GFP positive clones after reprogramming from Plate A for AP staining.
Extract RNA from Plate B for qPCR at time points day 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12.
Collect iPSC clones for further culture from Plate C.
Culture MEFs in iPSC medium daily for 12 days.
Perform colony formation assay (CFA) after reprogramming to evaluate efficiency.
Stain iPSC colonies with alkaline phosphatase for 1 hour.
Wash stained clones three times with PBS.
Count positively stained colonies and compare between experimental and control groups.
Harvest cells at the 12th day during reprogramming.
Wash harvested cells twice with PBS.
Analyze OCT4-GFP positive cell number by flow cytometry.
Extract RNA from cells to check pluripotency gene expressions.
Extract total RNA from cell pellets using RNAzol reagent.
Synthesize cDNA using Primescript RT Master Mix.
Perform qPCR using SYBR qPCR Master Mix on LightCycler 480 II system.
Calculate the fold change of experimental group versus control group.
Determine Ct value with Ct = Ct (test gene) - Ct (Ref. gene).
Calculate the fold change for a test gene in experimental group versus control group with FC = 2ˆ(-Ct).
Test each gene in triplicates in every independent experiment.
Triplicate all experiments.
